name: 1st Dalai Lama
role: Spiritual leader of Tibet from 1391 to 1474
contribution: A student of Je Tsongkhapa, and became his first Khenpo at Ganden Monastery.

checks.lead: The 1st Dalai Lama, Gedun Drupa (Tibetan: དགེ་འདུན་གྲུབ་པ།, Wylie: dge 'dun grub pa) (1391–1474) was a student of Je Tsongkhapa, and became his first Khenpo (Abbott) at Ganden Monastery. He also founded Tashi Lhunpo Monastery in Shigatse. He was posthumously awarded the spiritual title of Dalai Lama.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
